skippercast.summary: Phone-first fishing map and ocean forecast for boat anglers on California's Central Coast (v0.8; Morro Bay & Avila active, 15 preview regions). MapLibre GL + PMTiles over a self-hosted Protomaps basemap (Night/Day), ENC chart, 2D/3D terrain via Three.
layers_from_repo: swell field (0–15 ft, period isolines, direction strokes)
skippercast.note: The phrases 'subsea weather' and 'raw general base layer map' do not appear in the public repo; mapped here to the closest layers (currents/water temp; basemap + ENC + seafloor). Source: README.md, docs/web-app.md, docs/plans/front-end/design.md §9, web/tokens.css.

ranked_examples.title: Open Waters Seascape: global seafloor chart tiles
ranked_examples.why: Ocean-first map: continuous depth shading, hillshade, contours and spot soundings from a 34-source mosaic (GEBCO, EMODnet, NOAA S-102, CUDEM). Islands read as sculpted relief rising from smooth blue gradients. Served as MapLibre tiles.

style.colormap: Monochrome blue depth ramp (light shallow to dark deep); README offers ?shading=relief|bands (ENC depth-area bands)
style.layering: OSM raster base (optional) > raster-dem colour relief > hillshade > depare depth areas > contour lines > soundings and labels
style.typography: Contour and sounding labels from vector tiles; units switch via ?unit=m|ft|fm
style.data_density: Medium: dense contours at zoom, soundings only at high zoom
style.lighting_shading: Raster-DEM hillshade on Terrarium-encoded depth; optional 3D via map.setTerrain
style.tools_technique: MapLibre GL raster-dem (encoding: terrarium) + MVT vectors (depare, contours, soundings); build pipeline BSD-3; tiles CC BY 4.0

ranked_examples.skippercast_mapping: Raw base layer: drop-in or reference for SkipperCast's seafloor/depth contours; the ?safety= hazard shading and fathom/feet ladders match boat use

ranked_examples.title: NOAA S-102 gridded bathymetry, web-rendered
ranked_examples.why: High-resolution S-102 grid shaded with a soft cyan-to-navy ramp; channels, sand waves and shoals read like a photograph of the seabed. Land is flat green so the water carries the detail.

style.colormap: Cyan to navy sequential (close to a Blues ramp), shallow = light
style.layering: Flat land fill > depth colour > hillshade multiply
style.lighting_shading: Strong seafloor hillshade on high-res grid
style.tools_technique: Author's own map stack (renderer not named in this post; he builds ocean map infra at Zydro); data NOAA S-102

ranked_examples.skippercast_mapping: Raw base layer and seafloor: the same look for Central Coast where S-102/BlueTopo grids exist

shortlist.what: Adopt or mimic the Open Waters Seascape stack: Terrarium raster-dem relief + hillshade + MVT contours/soundings in MapLibre (same stack SkipperCast already uses). Try ?shading=bands for an ENC look and ?unit=ft.
Upgrade the existing canvas streamlines to fading particle trails over a speed-coloured field (cmocean speed), keeping --flow #dffcf6 for the trails.
Strong hillshade on the highest-res grid (S-102/BlueTopo) with a 7-stop cyan-to-navy ramp on sqrt(depth) (rsimmon tip); flat land.
Animate swell direction strokes at a speed tied to period; keep the 0–15 ft field; add a glow for the top band on Night.
Rayshader-style 'drained' Monterey/Morro Bay preset: soft shadows, ambient occlusion, translucent water plane at 0 m in the Three scene.
